headline: 4-4, 8th, and a streak that ended at two
story: Week 8 was a 110.54 to 81.14 loss to CMac91, the closest game of the week. Matthew Golden led at 20.9 and 10.0 stayed on a 15.9-point bench. He added Samaje Perine for free, dropping Zachariah Branch, and fell one spot to 8th at 4-4.
His 884.36 points are 10th in the league. FAAB is $449 and his MAXPF of 1082.84 holds the 1.04. The market feed lists Jeremiyah Love Out, with 18.2% of his roster's value sidelined. Sarge71 is next.
